PRISM Fellowship
Promoting Research and Inclusion in STEM through a fully-funded transformative research opportunity for students from disadvantaged backgrounds
Offered in collaboration with the National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS) Bangalore
About the PRISM Fellowship 2026

Hosted at the National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS) in Bangalore, the PRISM Fellowship is a 2-month immersive, residential research programme designed to nurture the next generation of life science researchers from underrepresented and marginalised backgrounds in India.

At its core, the PRISM Fellowship addresses the critical need for hands-on research experience combined with comprehensive academic skill development at the early career stage for individuals who face systemic barriers. Accordingly, it offers a unique dual-component structure: an
intensive laboratory placement
at one of India’s premier research institutions, coupled with a structured
academic skills programme
. Selected fellows will be embedded in an NCBS research laboratory, while simultaneously developing academic and professional skills through weekly structured sessions.
The Fellowship also focuses on community-building and networking, fostering connections with experienced researchers and peers in the field.
By the end of the programme, PRISM Fellows will be equipped with

the skills, knowledge, and networks necessary for academic and professional success in STEM fields, while also being part of a growing community of researchers committed to inclusivity and scientific excellence.

FELLOWSHIP STRUCTURE

The PRISM Fellowship consists of two core components: a laboratory placement that provides hands-on research experience, and an academic skills programme designed to develop essential competencies for a career in STEM.
1. Laboratory Placement:

Fellows will be placed in NCBS research labs where they will work under the guidance of experienced faculty mentors on cutting-edge scientific research projects based on their area of interest. They will gain practical experience in experimental design, data collection, and analysis while contributing to real-world research problems. Fellows will have the opportunity to engage in weekly lab meetings and discussions, fostering a deeper understanding of their research fields. By the end of the programme, each fellow will produce a report summarising their findings.
2. Academic Skills Programme:

In parallel with their laboratory placement, Fellows will participate in a structured academic skills programme that includes weekly workshops and lectures. This programme is designed to provide the foundational skills necessary for academic and professional success in STEM fields. It will cover key topics such as scientific research & methodologies, understanding experimental design and data analysis, research ethics & integrity, academic writing & publications, graduate school preparation, writing statements of purpose, CVs and research proposal, etc.

Through these two components, the PRISM Fellowship ensures that fellows receive both practical research training and academic skill-building opportunities, preparing them for further studies and professional careers in STEM.

WHY APPLY?

The PRISM Fellowship offers a comprehensive research experience, equipping selected fellows with skills, knowledge, and networking opportunities essential for academic and professional success. Benefits include:
✅ Hands-on Research: Work on cutting-edge projects in NCBS laboratories.
✅ Expert Mentorship: Receive guidance from leading scientists and faculty.
✅ Academic Skill Development: Participate in structured training sessions.
✅ Networking & Exposure: Engage with top researchers and attend NCBS seminars.
✅ Financial Support: Accommodation and a stipend for living expenses.
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
You are eligible for the PRISM Fellowship, if:

you are currently pursuing a master's degree or are currently in the third or fourth year of a four-year bachelor’s degree, the third year of a three-year bachelor’s degree, or the third to fifth year of an integrated/ dual degree in any science subject, and will remain so for the duration of the fellowship,
you are disadvantaged due to social position, economic barriers, geography, or similar factors, and
you are passionate about life sciences particularly developmental biology, genetics, ecology, neurobiology and bioinformatics.

We strongly encourage applications from students from underrepresented and marginalised communities in STEM particularly SC, ST, OBC, PwD, religious minorities, women and gender minorities and Northeast India communities.

FAQs for Potential Applicants
Q1. What is the PRISM Fellowship?

The PRISM Fellowship, a collaboration between Project EduAccess and the National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS), is a 2-month immersive fully-funded research programme designed to nurture the next generation of life science researchers from underrepresented and marginalised backgrounds in India. The Fellowship offers lab placements at NCBS, fostering connections with experienced researchers and scientists at NCBS.
Q2. When will applications open for the PRISM Fellowship 2026?
Applications for the PRISM Fellowship are open from Friday, 10 April 2026 to Sunday, 19 April 2026.
Q3. When will applications close for the PRISM Fellowship 2026?
Applications for the PRISM Fellowship will close at 11:59 PM IST, Sunday, 19 April 2026.
Q4. Does the PRISM Fellowship 2026 provide lab placements at institutions across India?
No, the PRISM Fellowship offers lab placements only at NCBS Bangalore. It is distinct from the
, for which applications for the 2026 cycle have already closed.
Q5. How is the PRISM Fellowship distinct from the PRISM National Fellowship?

The PRISM Fellowship is a collaboration between Project EduAccess and the National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS) offering lab placements only at NCBS. On the other hand, the PRISM National Fellowship is a collaboration between Project EduAccess, the National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS) and the Indian Society of Developmental Biologists (InSDB). It offers lab placements in leading research institutions and labs across India. Both Fellowships are 2-month immersive fully-funded research programmes designed to nurture the next generation of life science researchers from underrepresented and marginalised backgrounds in India. Applications for the PRISM National Fellowship 2026 have already closed.

Q7. Will I receive an acknowledgment email upon submitting my application?
Yes, you will see an on-screen acknowledgement immediately after submitting your application. We will also separately confirm your application via an email from
info@projecteduaccess.com
within 5 days of your submission. Ensure that you enter the correct email address and that you check your inbox and spam regularly.
Q8. Can undergraduate students apply for the PRISM Fellowship?

Yes, the PRISM Fellowship 2026 is open to undergraduate students, but only if you are in the third or fourth year of a four-year bachelor’s degree, or the third year of a three-year bachelor’s degree in a science subject, and will remain so for the duration of the fellowship.
Q9. Are students enrolled on integrated or dual degrees eligible to apply for the PRISM Fellowship?

​Yes, the PRISM Fellowship 2026 is open to students enrolled on integrated or dual degrees (e.g. BS-MS), provided you are in the third, fourth or fifth year of an integrated or dual degree in a science subject, and will remain so for the duration of the fellowship.
Q10. Can students who have completed their bachelor’s degree or master's degree apply for the PRISM Fellowship?
No, the PRISM Fellowship 2026 is open only to those who are students at the time of application and will remain so for the duration of the fellowship.
Q11. When will I hear back after applying for the Fellowship?
Please refer to the timeline above.
Q12. What if I do not hear back as per the timeline?

It is highly unlikely that you will not receive a response from us as per the timeline. However, if this does occur, please check your inbox as well as your spam folder. If you still have not received any communication from us, you can reach out to us at
Q13. Will I be notified if I am not selected for the PRISM Fellowship?
Yes, we will inform all applicants, whether selected or not, about the outcome of their application.
Q14. Someone has asked me to pay a fee to be considered for the PRISM Fellowship. Should I pay?
No, you should not pay any fees. The PRISM Fellowship 2026 is completely free of cost. If anyone asks you for money claiming to be associated with us, please report them immediately to
Q15. What happens after I am selected for the PRISM Fellowship?

If you are selected, you will receive an email from us informing you about your selection. This email will include a deadline by which you need to confirm your acceptance. Once you confirm, you will go through an onboarding process where we will provide further details to you.
Q16. What happens if I am not selected for the PRISM Fellowship?

Due to our limited capacity, we can only accept a small number of Fellows into the PRISM Fellowship. If you are not selected, it does not reflect on your merit or qualifications. Selection is a careful decision based on various factors, including your profile, the disadvantages you have faced, and the availability of an appropriate lab placement at NCBS. Regardless of the outcome, we will inform you about the decision and provide further guidance if possible.
